transit.name: The Lift
transit.detail: Free transit service year-round to and from Winter Park Resort, Downtown Winter Park, Fraser, Granby and Grand Lake

nameOrigin.text: The village of Hideaway Park was incorporated and renamed Winter Park in 1978, taking the name of the neighboring Winter Park Ski Area at West Portal.

timeline.text: The Moffat Tunnel was built, and the rail route over Rollins Pass was no longer needed.
Doc and Helen Graves bought 10 acres on April 20 in what is now Winter Park.
Winter Park Ski Area opened with its first ski tow and three trails.
The City and County of Denver transferred operation of the ski area to the Winter Park Recreation Association.
The village of Hideaway Park was incorporated and renamed Winter Park.
